What's new in Sonault 1.8.0

  • Credits. Sounds imported from YouTube or Freesound now carry a ready-made credit line — the original title, the creator, and the link — with a button that copies it straight into a video description or a game's credits screen. Open the arrow next to the button to see exactly what will be copied.
  • Mark what you owe. Each sound can be set to no credit needed or credit required, with room for the licence or receipt alongside it. Sounds you haven't decided about stay untouched — Sonault never guesses your rights for you.
  • Sounds that need a credit show a small @ next to the details button, so you can see at a glance what still owes an attribution. ⌘K has a Needs Credit tab that lists exactly those.
  • Select several sounds to mark them all at once, or copy every credit line together — enough to assemble a whole project's credits in one go.
  • Dragging a sound into another app now exports it under the name you gave it in Sonault, instead of an internal filename.
  • Tooltips appear noticeably faster throughout the app, and buttons on the sign-in and account screens now respond across their whole area rather than only on the text.
